title: VirusVaccine feature scope
scope: Product design requirements and implementation status. No machine inventory, test run details, or private evidence is published.

features.name: Device dashboard and feature navigation
features.design_requirement: Show actual engine availability, database age, active job and recent results; distinguish unavailable capabilities from working protection.

features.name: Quick scan and job controls
features.design_requirement: Provide bounded scan scope, accurate running/paused/cancelled/completed/error states, progress, failures and timestamps. Do not describe interrupted or errored scans as clean.

features.name: Full scan
features.design_requirement: Let the user review the target volumes, bound traversal, skip symlinks/reparse points and report skipped or inaccessible files.

features.name: Selected file or folder scan
features.design_requirement: A native file/folder picker can provide independently implemented custom scans without copying the proprietary shell extension.

features.name: Real-time protection and exclusions
features.design_requirement: Expose only actual monitoring. A user-space folder watcher must be labeled as such; it is not a kernel on-access blocker.

features.name: Scheduled scans
features.design_requirement: Persist schedule settings and explain whether the app must remain open. Do not imply background service guarantees before implementing and testing them.

features.name: Quarantine review
features.design_requirement: Quarantine only verified detections with recorded source identity, destination integrity checks and reversible metadata. Require explicit restore/delete confirmation; prevent overwrite and path substitution.

features.name: Security reports and history
features.design_requirement: Persist append-only scan outcomes with clear coverage and errors, provide local report export and avoid false protection scores.

features.name: Advanced Firewall
features.design_requirement: Do not claim an independent firewall from antivirus file scanning. Treat network filtering as a separate subsystem and show unsupported status until implemented.

features.name: Tracker and temporary-file cleanup
features.implementation: partial: companion cookie/cache cleanup per browser profile
features.design_requirement: Require explicit selection and confirmation. Cookies default off. Keep history, passwords, bookmarks and unrelated profile data. No system cleanup.

features.name: File shredding
features.design_requirement: If added, explain storage-specific limits and require explicit scoped deletion confirmation; do not promise secure erasure on SSDs or synced storage without evidence.

features.name: Secure VPN
features.design_requirement: Guide official WireGuard client and provider configuration; no tunnel control or claimed connection state.

features.name: Per-browser web protection
features.implementation: partial: tracker rules and offline link checks
features.design_requirement: Companion blocks a small packaged third-party tracker list; no phishing/malware reputation feed. Desktop cannot verify installation.

features.name: Password manager
features.design_requirement: Treat a password vault as a separate security product; do not store or import credentials during antivirus comparison.

features.name: Identity monitoring
features.design_requirement: Guide HIBP breach-alert signup; email and notifications stay with the provider. No integrated identity monitor.

features.name: Text-scam protection
features.design_requirement: Pasted English-language text receives bounded heuristic explanations; no automatic SMS integration or trained scam classifier.

features.name: Email-scam protection
features.design_requirement: Paste message text for local heuristics; no inbox access, sender authentication or automatic email monitoring.

features.name: Video/deepfake alerts
features.design_requirement: Do not infer deepfake classification from ClamAV integration; this would be a distinct research and evaluation project.

features.name: Version and update information
features.design_requirement: Report engine and signature versions separately, verify downloads and show update failure or stale definitions plainly.

features.name: Idle-aware background work
features.design_requirement: Keep scan CPU/memory use bounded and document any optional scheduling policy.

features.name: Access protection
features.design_requirement: Do not describe an ordinary desktop app as tamper protected; signed services/drivers and a threat model are separate engineering work.

features.name: Misleading browser-notification detection
features.design_requirement: Treat notification filtering as an optional browser subsystem; avoid global browser-setting changes.

features.name: Notification preferences
features.design_requirement: Separate security-result notifications from optional informational messages.

features.name: Account, subscription, devices and help
features.design_requirement: An open-source local scanner can work without an account; do not reproduce proprietary subscriptions or cloud services as fake working features.
